# Third-party marks

Files here are the official marks of products and companies that Rise videos name. Use them as
shipped: never recolor, crop, redraw or stretch them. Add a row for every mark you add.

Where a mark may come from, in this order (see `references/logos.md`):
1. the company's own site or press kit;
2. Gil Barbara's "SVG Logos" set (`@iconify-json/logos` on npm, CC0), which reproduces official
   marks in full color;
3. Simple Icons (`simple-icons` on npm, CC0), one-color marks in each brand's official hex.
